name: Reanimated
description: Reanimated are corpses who have been brought back to life.

features.name: Stitch Up
features.description: During a rest, you can only clear Hit Points if you have access to remains from a recently deceased creature. Describe how using this material affects your appearance. You cannot clear Hit Points by any means except a downtime move or the Risk It All death move.

features.name: Corpse
features.description: When you Risk It All on a death move, if you fail, you can permanently mark a Hit Point to succeed instead. When you do, you still use the Hope Die's value to clear Hit Points and Stress.
